notes.title: Runehaven v.0.12.0 - New Demo Update!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I hope you all had a great summer! I just wanted to let you know that I have finally released an updated version of the demo. As you may know, a lot of development has been done since I released the last demo, so there have been many many changes. Some of the things I've worked on are melee magic, overhauling the tutorial, modding support and visual improvements among other things. Let me know if you stumble upon any weird bugs. I will try to update the demo more frequently from now on until the release of the game.[/p][p]Have a good one![/p]

notes.title: Rune System Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I just wanted to give you a small progress update and let you know that I've done some work on the runic magic system based on some of your feedback! It is now possible to bind spells to melee and ranged weapons using the runic magic system. Previously, you couldn't bind spells to melee and ranged weapons directly and had to instead rely on using an enchantment table. This meant that you had to find an enchantment table and then already have the runes in your inventory in order to bind the runes. So there was no way to change the runes of a melee or ranged weapon on the fly. I have scratched the idea of using enchantment tables and replaced it with the runic magic system instead.

Let me know if you have suggestions or stumble upon any issues, your feedback is always appreciated!

notes.title: Small Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since the last update. I just want to let you know that development is still ongoing and a lot of progress has been made!

I've spent some time improving the terrain generation and terrain shader. Here's an early screenshot of it:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733812/99cd3c47fbf88fbf5e2e34ecb24ed7fc22d716be.png[/img]

As shown in the screenshot, the game now has biomes with smooth blending and we're no longer constrained to only using voxel blocks. The biome blending also means that the world is no longer separated into different maps. Each biome smoothtly transitions into the next one which allows for backtracking and a more seamless experience.  The new terrain system also runs much faster, the scene in the screenshot above ran at about 390-400 FPS on my laptop!

I have also worked on adding more potions. So now there are a total of 11 different potions available in the game.

notes.title: Quick Progress Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I realized that it's been a while since I made a post here so I thought I'd make an update on the progress!

There have been lots of changes in the past weeks to the game. I've spent a considerable time working on improving the dungeon generation but I've also added modifiers, a new rune and new mob type. Since the changes are so vast, it will take a while before I release an update to the demo. I think it needs some more work before that. I am very sorry about that!

[b]Dungeon generation[/b]
When it comes to dungeon geneneration, there are now new interesting room shapes to add further variety to the dungeon layouts. More are planned for the future! A lot of time has been spent on adding more variety to the tilesets. The game can now modify tilesets to create interesting effects such as add cracks and erosion. I also decided to use a technique called the nine-slice technique for placing out the tiles. This makes it possible to, for example, change how the walls look near the floor or near the ceiling.

[b]New rune[/b]
I have also added a new rune to the game related to summoning. This rune can also be combined with pretty much all the other runes in the game so there's a lot of room for experimentation with it like the other runes.

[b]Modifiers[/b]
I have also worked on adding modifiers to the game to add more variety to the weapons and armor in the game. Some examples of modifiers are "+3 to armor" or "8% to damage", etc. Some modifiers are only applicable to certain item types such as melee weapons or magic weapons but most of them are for any item. There are now around 20 modifiers available in the game.

[b]New mob type[/b]
I've also added a new mob type that is called an elemental. As you may suspect, the mob can come in different elemental forms such as fire, water, earth, etc. It will mostly be found in certain biomes related to specific elements. For example, you might find ice elementals in ice caves.

notes.title: Runehaven v0.8.6 - More Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! A big thanks to everyone that has played the demo and given feedback, I truly appreciate it!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed glowing eyes on dead enemies.
[*] Updated the procedural dungeon layouts so that they feel slightly less claustrophobic. This was done by introducing the possibility for greater ceiling heights. Also, some of the algorithms used for creating layouts are now catered towards also creating more open spaces occasionally. Hopefully, these changes will add more variety to the maps and make the dungeons feel less cramped overall.
[*] Increased brightness of torch.
[*] Updated the post processing so that darker areas are not as dark as before.
[*] Updated the loot system so runebinders get more runes.
[*] Fixed issue where off-hand melee attack was triggered when using magic scrolls.
[*] Fixed issue where willpower skill could not be upgraded on 1920x1080 monitors.
[*] Updated sticky bombs so that they now stick properly to mobs.
[*] Fixed regression that caused bombs to not immediately explode when hitting mobs.
[*] Updated the damage balancing of some runes.
[*] There's now a small chance for smaller mobs to hide in urns, crates and barrels.
[/list]

notes.title: Runehaven v0.8.0 - Classes, Enchantment & More!
notes.content:
[b]Summary[/b]

In preparation for Steam next fest, I have finally finished a pretty large update for the game. In this update, I initially focused on improving the difficulty curve of getting into the game by improving tutorials, adding more feedback, etc, but I ended up adding some new features and fixing some bugs I noticed.

[list]
[*] You can now choose a class when starting a run. Currently, you can choose between playing as a warrior, runebinder or archer. Each class has different advantages.
[*] Added perlin noise elevation to terrain. This adds some more verticality to the dungeons which makes them feel a bit more interesting in my opinion.
[*] Added iron pickaxe. The pickaxe can be used to more efficiently destroy the environment to for example, find shortcuts, etc.
[*] Added iron mace weapon.
[*] Added wooden barrel prop.
[*] Added explosive barrel prop.
[*] Added wooden longbow weapon.
[*] Added wooden shortbow weapon
[*] Added arrows ammo item.
[*] Added visual tutorial when crafting spells.
[*] Add drawn runes in center under grid when crafting spells.
[*] Added corridor room shape.
[*] Removed mobs too close to the dungeon entrance to prevent spooky mob surprise attacks.
[*] Fixed an issue where slimes could spawn inside stairs.
[*] Made the torch lights flicker to add to the atmosphere.
[*] Added main menu soundtrack.
[*] Fixed issue with overpowered critical strike for projectiles.
[*] Added metal spike piston floor traps.
[*] The agility skill now also increases the stamina regeneration speed.
[*] Improved lever visuals and animation.
[*] Added message "A portcullis has opened..." when opening a portcullis with a lever.
[*] Added crystal particles to cave maps for atmosphere.
[*] Extended the demo run with a few more maps.
[*] Added ambient occlusion toggle in graphics settings.
[*] Weapon enchanting. It is now possible to enchant melee and ranged weapons. So far, only certain runes can be used for enchanting but more will be added soon the future. The runes that can be used for enchanting melee weapons and/or ranged weapons are the light rune, fire rune, water rune, harmful rune, bounce rune and seek rune.
[*] Added a new custom dungeon room that contains an enchantment table.
[*] Added a new cave soundtrack.
[*] Added pick up item sound.
[*] Fixed issue related to picking up items when inventory is full.
[*] Added "Inventory is full." text message when attempting to pick up item when inventory is full.
[/list]

[i]As always, let me know if you see anything odd going on. This update in particular is pretty large so I wouldn't be surprised if there's some bugs lurking around somewhere! :-) Have a good one![/i]

This was trickier to implement than I expected and lots of functionality had to rewritten in order for it to work but it was definitely worth it. One caveat though, some special utility controls (such as F3 for toggling debug info) is not available for the gamepad currently because of the limited number of gamepad keys available. However, all gameplay-related controls should work on the gamepad.

[*] Increased range of mouse sensitivity slider.
[*] Slightly increased durability for magic weapons (staves, wands, scepters, etc).
[*] Small visual changes to magic system. The grid dots now spin when they are activated.

notes.title: Runehaven v0.7.5 - Magic Scrolls & More
notes.content:
[b]Summary[/b]

[list]

[*] Added 5 magic scroll items. More will be added in the future!
[*] Added speed stats to melee weapons. So melee weapons now have different attack speeds, some weapons are faster than others.

[*] Started working on the final boss battle. I don't want to give away too much info on this other than to let you know that there will be bosses in the game. There will probably be two or three bosses when the game is released. I know that some players aren't too keen on boss battles. If that's the case, let me know and I can perhaps add an option for not including boss battles when starting the run.
[/list]

As always, let me know if you have any requests/suggestions or see any odd things going on in the game. Have a good one!

notes.title: Runehaven v0.7.4 - Stairway Improvements, FOV, Quick hotkeys and more!
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added FOV slider in graphics settings.
[*] Added hotkey for quick healing. The default key is H but it can be remapped in the controls settings.
[*] Added hotkey for quick mana. The default is G but it can be remapped in the key mapping menu. As you may know, the key for dropping items used to be G so the default key for dropping is now X instead. The default quick mana key can also be remapped in the control settings.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the wrong rune to be identified.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the wrong weapon to be destroyed when running out of condition.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the wrong armor to be destroyed when running out of condition.
[*] Added support for wider procedural stairways. The previous narrow stairways felt a tad bit claustrophobic so I decided to mix this up with wider stairways to add more variety.
[*] Added support for loading GLTF 2.0 files for importing custom animations made in external software such as Blender.
[*] Updated animations and AI logic for melee skeleton.
[*] Updated animations and AI logic for arbalist skeleton.
[/list]

The new procedural stairway algorithm occasionally form these single-stairway exits which happened accidentally but I thought looked pretty nice:

Hi! In this update, I have focused on making improvements and fixing bugs. I'm utterly thankful for all the awesome feedback that everyone has given, it has been of tremendous help and it's fun to hear your thoughts.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved minimap by fading out rooms that are further away vertically. This makes it possible to distinguish overlapping rooms from one another.
[*] Fixed issue causing doors to push the player out of the map.
[*] Added door open/close animation.
[*] Fixed issue causing the left hand weapon to not update correctly when swapping the item in the left hand slot.
[*] Fixed issue causing items to not get dropped when dragging them outside the inventory.
[*] Fixed issues with stacking spell sounds.
[*] Added a notificiation regarding the dual-wielding feature in the tutorial.
[*] Fixed issue causing the interact key to not get re-mapped correctly.
[*] Fixed issue where the FPS indicator (when pressing F3) stopped working when pausing the game.

notes.title: Runehaven v0.6.0 - Armor & Minimap Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Armor system. The inventory now contains 4 armor slots (helmet, chestplate, trousers and boots). Currently, there are only two armor sets (8 armor items) but I am planning on adding more armor items in the future. The damage received from enemies is reduced until the armor breaks.
[*] Leather armor set.
[*] Iron armor set.
[*] Added opening sequence when starting a new game. It can be skipped by pressing the escape key.
[*] Improved the minimap readability by color coding more objects in the game. The doorways now have a more noticeable orange color instead of the old yellow color that didn't stand out from the rest of the map. The portcullises are now cyan, the locked doors are violet, the player is blue, the entrance door is green and the exit door is red. These changes will hopefully make it easier to navigate the map.
[*] Added missing tags to certain items that prevented them from being used correctly by the new loot system.
[/list]

notes.title: Runehaven v0.5.1 - Some Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced old tutorial with a new notification-based tutorial that feels less intrusive. Instead of displaying a dialog that pauses the game, helpful information shows up in the top-right corner as a small notification during the start of the game instead.
[*] Improved loot system to ensure more interesting loot variety. I noticed that some players were struggling to find specific items such as melee weapons during a run due to the way the previous loot system worked. This new loot system attempts to fix this issue. When classes are added to the game, the loot system will likely become even better in this regard.
[*] Play sound when opening and closing the inventory.
[*] Play sound when opening and closing the character stats panel.
[/list]

notes.title: Runehaven v0.5.0 - Dual Wielding
notes.content:
Hello! Here's a last update before christmas.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Support for dual wielding weapons. When you press the F key (or any other key you have bound it to), the current weapon is placed in the[i] left hand[/i] slot. You can also drag a weapon manually to the left hand slot in the inventory. When dual wielding weapons, the left mouse button will be used for attacking with the left weapon and the right mouse button for attacking with the right weapon.
[*] Potions can now be used directly using the alpha keys.
[*] Changed the default inventory key button from 'I' to 'Tab'.
[/list]

If there's something you would like to see in the game or if you encounter any issues, feel free to contact me.

Merry christmas and happy new year!

notes.title: Runehaven v0.2.9 - Level System Overhaul
notes.content:
Hello! In this update, I have worked primarily on adding character stats and reworked the user interface. I thought the old user interface felt a little uninspiring so I took inspiration from old retro RPG games to make something with a little bit more character.

The current stats so far are:
[list]
[*] Agility: Increases movement speed.
[*] Dexterity: Ranged weapon damage bonus.
[*] Strength: Melee weapon damage bonus.
[*] Intellect: Magic damage bonus.
[*] Rejuvenation: Increased mana regeneration speed.
[*] Vitality: Increased maximum health.
[*] Willpower: Increased maximum mana.
[/list]
[b]Summary:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the user interface (panels, slots, buttons, etc).
[*] Replaced card-based stats system with a more traditional point-based system.
[*] Add 7 different stats the player can upgrade when leveling up.
[*] Add wooden wand and rune to spawn items.
[/list]

Here's a screenshot of the user interface:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733812/887baa5c37d1e29be15fd116de9c58f6baf8060d.png[/img]

Try out the demo [url=https://cikoriastudio.itch.io/runehaven-demo]here[/url].

notes.title: Runehaven v0.2.8 - More Magic!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In this update, I spent some more time on the runic magic system. I feel like there's a lot to explore there so this probably won't be the last update for it. First and foremost, the grid interface for drawing the runes have been updated with new outlines so it looks a bit more exciting. Here's a screenshot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733812/e28c3c6fe1d6941ca2fc9298f13bc0088279451e.png[/img]

I also think the outline helps a bit when it comes to drawing the runes.

On the same topic, I have also added some new runes to the game. There are now a total of six runes in the game. There will be more in the future!

Other than that, I have made small fixes and improvements here and there. Here's a summary of the update:

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved runic magic interface.
[*] Changed menu button click sound.
[*] Added gamma slider in graphics settings.
[*] Added new runes.
[*] Improved performance by disabling debug log printing in the build.
[*] Updated UI in main menu and pause menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with tooltip when hovering over exit doors.
[*] Updated icon.
[/list]
Try out the demo [url=https://cikoriastudio.itch.io/runehaven-demo]here[/url].
